hook: A new speculative decoder, tested on two tiny supercomputers.

beats.say: Tencent open sourced DFly2, its speculative decoding drafter, with weights, training code and a report. A developer quickly ported it to DeepSeek on two NVIDIA GB10 Sparks.
In the test, every output matched the no draft reference, all nine hundred fifty nine tokens.
Estimated decode speed was forty five tokens per second for DFly2, against seventy five for DSpark and thirty eight with no drafting, so DSpark still wins here.
